bnb.name: Bnb - Banco do Nordeste
bnb.shortDescription: Banco do Nordeste card app, allowing invoice control, limits management and much more.
bnb.longDescription: App developed for Banco do Nordeste, focused on credit card management. Features include invoice control, real-time expense tracking, limit setting, etc. The app was built with Flutter using clean architecture, ensuring scalability and easy maintenance.

banpara.name: Banpara - Banco do Pará
banpara.shortDescription: Credit card solution and expense control for Banpara clients, with multiple features.
banpara.longDescription: Banpara credit card app, developed with Flutter. Features include invoice management, real-time purchase notifications, limit adjustment and digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay).

losango.name: Losango - Banco Losango
losango.shortDescription: Losango app for card management, expense control and flexible installments.
losango.longDescription: App development for Banco Losango, offering users expense tracking, installments and direct support. Integrated with a white-label architecture that allowed quick adaptation for other banks.

h2club.name: H2 Club - Groupe H2
h2club.shortDescription: App for tournament management, schedule and H2 club information, with push notifications.
h2club.longDescription: App for H2 Club members, displaying tournament calendar, results, reservations and segmented push notification integration. Implements facial/document recognition for registration and LGPD compliance.

bluec.name: BlueC - Banco BlueC
bluec.shortDescription: BlueC Bank app, integrating digital wallets for immediate payment.
bluec.longDescription: Digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay) into BlueC app, facilitating contactless payments and real-time transaction management.

afinz.name: Afinz - Banco Afinz
afinz.shortDescription: Afinz Bank with digital banking features, card control and intuitive interface.
afinz.longDescription: Creation of the Afinz Bank app, focused on complete digital banking features: account opening, credit cards, bill payments and service top-ups. Strong emphasis on UI/UX.

komus.name: Komus - Mobile Insurance
komus.shortDescription: Mobile phone insurance app, with plans and integrated support. Brand merged with Pitz Insurance.
komus.longDescription: App developed to offer mobile insurance plans, with claim registration features, repair tracking and 24h support channel. Later, the Komus brand was incorporated into Pitz Insurance.

heiclub.name: HeiClub - Heineken
heiclub.shortDescription: Private project for Heineken clients, with points and digital payment integration.
heiclub.longDescription: Development of internal platform for Heineken, encompassing loyalty program (point redemption) and digital payment method integration. Access restricted to clients and employees.

prudential.name: BackOffice - Prudential
prudential.shortDescription: User management system and XLSX/CSV data export/import.
prudential.longDescription: Internal project for Prudential, including administrative interface for user registration and control. Allows data export to spreadsheets, plus import and automatic mapping of large volumes of information.

neopdv.name: NeoPDV - Dashboard
neopdv.shortDescription: Sales control dashboard and mobile POS for stores, with real-time metrics.
neopdv.longDescription: Solution focused on sales control, allowing salespeople to serve customers away from the cashier (mobile POS) and track goals and metrics through an intuitive web dashboard.

hero.title: About Me
hero.subtitle: Hi! I’m Pedro Ruffo, a developer with 6 years of experience in Flutter, UI/UX Design and web development. I’m passionate about building modern, functional interfaces that deliver exceptional experiences.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Mobile Software Engineer - Flutter | Dart | Firebase | Front-end Developer | UI/UX Designer. I have 6 years of experience, especially with Flutter and a strong focus on UI/UX. I love crafting modern, functional and engaging interfaces, ensuring performance and quality in every project.

roles.title: Principal Mobile Flutter Engineer
bullets: Define the technical vision and architecture of mobile applications, ensuring high performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
Lead strategic initiatives across the Flutter ecosystem, serving as a technical reference for multiple teams and driving architectural decisions, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
Lead complex integrations and collaborate closely with product, UX, and backend teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.
Mentor developers through technical guidance, advanced code reviews, and knowledge sharing, contributing to team growth and engineering excellence.

roles.title: Sr. Mobile Flutter Engineer | Sr. Front-end Software Engineer
bullets: Led the development of Grupo H2's LGPD compliance initiative, including the Responsible Gaming website, cookie policy, and privacy request workflow with facial and document recognition.
Developed multiple web platforms for Grupo H2, including the official Events website, Responsible Gaming website, Seu Bet +18, H2 Bet +18, and Unique Poker Tour.
Led the development of the H2 Club mobile application, providing members with real-time club schedules, tournament tracking, and personal account information.
Designed and implemented the application's JWT-based authentication and security architecture, ensuring secure access and data protection.
Implemented segmented push notifications using Flutter, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), and BigQuery data.
Developed solutions serving H2 Club locations in São Paulo, Curitiba, and Campinas, providing an integrated experience for club members.

roles.title: Sr. Mobile Flutter Engineer
bullets: Developed white-label credit card applications for Banpará, BNB, and Losango, focusing on expense tracking, invoice management, purchase analytics, and credit limit management.
Implemented tailored banking experiences for different financial institutions while maintaining a scalable and reusable architecture.
Applied Clean Architecture to build maintainable and scalable mobile applications.
Implemented digital wallet integrations supporting Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, focusing on security, performance, and user experience.
Contributed to Heineken's HeiClub loyalty platform, developing features for points redemption and digital payments.
Collaborated on backend solutions using .NET, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and integration with core business systems.
Developed an internal Prudential back-office platform for user management, including XLSX/CSV data import and export workflows.
Built a Flutter Web drag-and-drop interface to improve the usability and efficiency of administrative workflows.

roles.title: Mid-level Mobile Flutter Engineer | Mid-level Front-end Software Engineer
bullets: Developed a digital banking application for AFINZ, implementing mobile screens with a strong focus on UI/UX, product design, and intuitive user experiences.
Developed a credit card management application for Banco do Brasil, enabling customers to efficiently control and monitor their cards.
Collaborated on mobile banking solutions using Flutter, contributing to scalable and user-focused financial applications.

roles.title: Mid-level Mobile Flutter Engineer | Mid-level Front-end Software Engineer
bullets: Developed mobile applications using Flutter, focusing on performance, scalability, and clean architecture.
Developed the Komus Mobile App, a mobile insurance platform for contract management, claims, and plan tracking.
Built responsive and scalable web applications using Nuxt.js, Vue.js, Node.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Developed the Komus Insurance website, providing information about mobile protection plans, quote requests, and customer support features.

roles.title: Jr. Mobile Flutter Engineer | Jr. Front-end Software Engineer
bullets: Developed a mobile sales application with an integrated POS system, enabling sales associates to complete transactions both at fixed checkout stations and throughout the store.
Enabled a more dynamic and customer-focused sales experience by bringing the checkout process directly to the sales floor.
Designed the application's UI/UX, focusing on consistency, usability, and a seamless experience from product interaction to checkout.
Developed a web-based sales management dashboard for sellers and managers, supporting performance tracking and operational decision-making.
Implemented interactive charts, metrics, and reports for visualizing sales performance and operational data.
Built responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

roles.title: Helpdesk
bullets: Provided technical support to customers by phone, troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to point-of-sale terminals.
Investigated customer-reported issues and assisted in resolving operational and technical problems in POS environments.
